title: Mosque–Cathedral of Córdoba
geometryBasis: The named Q33200 OpenStreetMap multipolygon establishes the exact outer wall and courtyard opening. 137 attached map parts and 20 doors support subdivision, profiles, buttress and portal placement. The Mosque–Cathedral’s own records guide dimensions where the maps disagree.
sectionBasis: The official monument measures the bell tower at 54 m. The 1870s archive and 1905 courtyard print show persistent arch proportions, low surrounding gallery and layered belfry. The contemporary dedication carried by Qualla supports visible stone tones and horseshoe profile. The Renaissance nave and crossing stand above rows of terracotta mosque roofs.
limitations: This is a medium-fi exterior of the standing monument. Exact contemporary glazing, reliefs, sculpture, inscriptions, paged roof alterations, furnishings and interiors are outside the modeled detail.
Current map controls roof extents, registered doors and courtyard outline. Rough heights, ridge profiles, smaller annexes, gallery bay interval and cladding tones are approximated.
Historical archival views support surviving historic details. The 54 m official bell-tower height takes precedence over inconsistent map height tags.
